session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Identifier of the newly created debug session, used for subsequent control calls.

event.description: First debug event produced by the session (typically the initial stop or a termination).

file.title: File
file.description: Node-relative file execution is currently stopped in, if applicable.

line.title: Line
line.description: Line number execution is currently stopped at, if applicable.

index.title: Index
index.description: Position of this frame in the call stack.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the function this frame represents.

file.title: File
file.description: Node-relative file the frame is currently executing in.

line.title: Line
line.description: Current line number within the file.

value.title: Value
value.description: String representation of the variable's value, if available.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Additional metadata about the variable, if any.

children.title: Children
children.description: Nested child variables, for table/composite values.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Call stack at the time of the event, innermost frame first.

console.title: Console
console.description: Console output lines produced since the previous event.

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: Whether the run completed successfully, set on termination.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message, if the run terminated due to an error.

event.title: DebugEvent

404.description: Node not found, or script not found

410.description: Debug session is no longer running

500.description: debug runner harness missing, or luajit not found on the server

503.description: Lua runtime not built. Run `make linkiir` in the runtime directory.
